description: Obtaining Consultancy Services for conducting a feasibility study and preparing detailed plans for the extension of the Kelani Valley Railway Line beyond Avissawella up to Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025.10.21 for conducting a feasibility study and preparing detailed plans for the extension of the Kelani Valley Railway Line beyond Avissawella up to Ratnapura. Calling for Expressions of Interest for the purpose has been made under the National Competitive Bidding Procedure and eight (08) bidders have submitted interests thereon.  After evaluating the technical proposals submitted by the shortlisted bidders, financial proposals of 04 qualified firms have been opened. After evaluating the said financial proposals, the Consultants Procurement Committee has recommended to award the consultancy service contract for conducting a feasibility study and preparing detailed plans for the extension of the Kelani Valley Railway Line beyond Avissawella up to Ratnapura, to   M/s. Resources Development Consultants (Pvt) Ltd for a total sum of Rs.356.22 million (excluding Taxes). Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the relevant procurement as per the said recommendation, was approved by the Cabinet.
